verdict.rationale: Rippling offers a general REST API with search/filter and pagination and building custom dashboards/reports, suggesting some queryability of platform data, but there is no evidence of a dedicated identity/security event log, no mention of audit-log export, and no native SIEM streaming integration (e.g., Splunk, Datadog connectors). missing for 10: dedicated identity/audit event log schema, native SIEM streaming connector, documented export/webhook mechanism for security events, independent confirmation of SIEM integration.
